legend.en: When faced with an onrushing horde, the Forgefather’s warriors set fire to the earth beneath their feet, impeding their advance and throwing them into confusion.

when.en: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.

effect.en: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

legend.en: Having drawn their enemies in, Space Marine battle-brothers fall back and open fire at point-blank range before thundering forward to put any survivors to death.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

effect.en: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

legend.en: The Salamanders are masters of the flamer, wielding such weapons with supreme precision and utilising them even in the press of melee combat.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s Torrent weapons: Do not have [Blast]. Have [Close-Quarters]. Have +1 A.

legend.en: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.

legend.en: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks can: Re-roll hit rolls of 1. Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

legend.en: To open fire on warriors of the Salamanders is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

target.en: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.

effect.en: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can: Make a disembark move. Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
